checklists.name: Ruby on Rails Engineering Standards
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Ruby on Rails MVC, Active Record, Security, and Sidekiq background processing.

items.statement: Active Record queries use includes(), joins(), or preload() to eliminate N+1 database queries.
Controllers enforce Strong Parameters (params.require().permit()) to prevent mass assignment vulnerabilities.
Code passes RuboCop style analysis and Brakeman static security scanner without unaddressed high-severity alerts.
Background jobs executed via Sidekiq/ActiveJob are idempotent and handle retries gracefully without data duplication.
Database migrations are reversible (change method or explicit up/down) and indexed appropriately for query filters.
